issues.where: lower-left interior in front of the cottage, 2.60–9.57 s
issues.what: The foreground flakes change position, but a dense cluster of large flakes holds nearly the same shape and height above the ground for seven seconds. It reads as a hovering bank rather than particles falling and settling.
issues.fix: Let the dense foreground flakes fall at varied speeds and stop against the scenery or ground; retain only a sparse, depth-layered drift at rest.

issues.where: lower third of the sphere, 1.30–5.23 s
issues.what: The shake creates a convincing whiteout, but the clearing leaves a broad, nearly level opaque belt that thins in place. The belt reads more like a fog layer than a slowing whirl of particles in liquid.
issues.fix: Carry the visible curved flow into the clearing. Break the belt into uneven arcs that wrap around the scenery at different depths and lose speed and density as they settle.
